meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让编码智能体通过 OpenCode 调用不同大模型。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建编码智能体,并希望它们通过 OpenCode 使用多家模型。
copy.tagline_en: Make your coding agents call multiple LLMs through OpenCode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building coding agents and want them to use multiple LLMs through OpenCode.

howto.what: 装上后它把 OpenCode 接进 NanoClaw:按组把 agent 的后端从默认 claude 换成 OpenCode,从而用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型对话,并拷好所需文件、装依赖、重建镜像。
howto.when: 当你想让某个 agent 组改用 OpenCode 而非默认 claude 后端时,在主机上执行 `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` 并重启该组。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenCode provider 装到这个项目里
say.note: 会从 providers 分支拷文件、装依赖并重建镜像。

say.text: 把这个组切到 opencode 后端并重启
say.note: 写入 provider 配置后重启生效。

howto.what_en: Wires OpenCode into NanoClaw as an agent provider: copies provider files, installs deps, rebuilds the agent image, and lets a group run OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc. instead of the default claude backend.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a group to run on OpenCode instead of the default claude backend; switch it per group with `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`.

say_en.text: Install the OpenCode provider in this project
say_en.note: Copies files from the providers branch and rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Switch this group to the opencode backend and restart it
say_en.note: Writes the provider config, then restarts the group.

say_en.text: Set up DeepSeek with OPENCODE_PROVIDER and OPENCODE_MODEL
say_en.note: Writes .env; register the key in OneCLI.
